description: This file defines the ResourcePermission class, which encapsulates permissions (read, create, update, delete) for a resource within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to combine permissions with logical 'and' / 'or', and static methods to instantiate from arrays or data group permissions.

classes.name: ResourcePermission
classes.description: Class representing resource permissions (read, create, update, delete) with methods to combine, instantiate, and create from other permission representations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the permission flags (canRead, canCreate, canUpdate, canDelete).

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.

methods.name: andWith
methods.description: Returns a new ResourcePermission instance with permissions being the logical AND of this permission and another.

methods.name: orWith
methods.description: Returns a new ResourcePermission instance with permissions being the logical OR of this permission and another.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission instance from an array of permissions, with an optional default value.

methods.name: createFromDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission from a DataGroupPermission object.
